title: Seedance 2.5で30秒動画を生成してワンショット作品を作る
content:
Seedance 2.5で30秒動画を生成してワンショット作品を作る  
カット禁止とプロンプトで指定してもカットが入ることがあるので、複数回生成（例：4回）して当たりを引く
tips:

en.content:
Create a one-shot piece by generating a 30-second video in Seedance 2.5  
Even if you specify “no cuts” in the prompt, cuts may still appear, so generate multiple times (e.g., 4 times) until you get a good result

--- QUOTED TWEET ---
I’m submitting to the animation category of Renoise-san’s (@renoiseai) “Seedance 2.5 One-Shot Challenge”♪
I finally managed to make it as a one-shot 💦
@renoiseaijp 
#Seedance
Even if you specify “no cuts” in the prompt, it can still make cuts 💦
I did the gacha 4 times lol

This was generated with Renoise-san’s Seedance 2.5 in 30 seconds♪
I tried making it into a pleasant video where a local girl from Hawaii transitions from skateboarding to surfing♪🛹🏄️🌊
I think it would also be fun to have her jump from a dolphin onto a whale♪

I’ll post the screenshots in the replies ❤
Thank you very much (*ᴗ͈ˬᴗ͈)ꕤ*.ﾟ☘
